column1: # Corrections made while running this recipe; each names the rule it adds to the next relocation leaf.

column2: all four donor tests are main-method self tests named *Test; surefire runs none of them by name (no @Test)
column3: keep the donor names and bodies (outputs name the class) and add one M3JDK-authored JUnit endpoint class per family

column2: the resources observation prints thread-allocated bytes and elapsed nanos; the allocation figure differs by a few hundred bytes between packages (longer or shorter class-name strings)
column3: mask measured fields in the differential, keep structural counts (pages, spills, distinctBackings) exact

column2: the first reference oracle kept three leases open on a two-page budget (every access refused "all resident pages pinned") and read back under injected pressure (refused "no evictable pages")
column3: bound open leases to the resident budget minus one; close leases and stop injecting pressure before the final read-back

column2: a -Dtest run of another leaf's test in the same worktree left its XML in target/surefire-reports, and the package run did not clean it
column3: gate builds run mvn clean package; never reuse a worktree target directory across leaves

column2: a differential.sh edit sent through a shell heredoc turned \1 into a control character
column3: edit scripts with backslashes through a Python file written by the Write tool

column2: the first differential.sh spelled the donor package and paths; jdk_naming plan reported rewrites=1 for it (DOUBLE, KEBAB, PKG_M3, PKG_PATH_M3)
column3: scripts read every donor path and the donor package from RELOCATION_MAP.tsv (as transient-facade-20261106/differential.sh does); run jdk_naming plan on scripts too
